gates.name: Player compatibility
gates.evidence: Live 2026-11-02: VISIONOS (no player script, no streaming token) answers OK with direct URLs for dQw4w9WgXcQ, and eXcor extracts from it. Its player request no longer sends youtube.com's Referer, which YouTube answers with 403. PlayerJsTest passes offline. Owner's PC, home network (Switzerland), 2026-11-03: the watch page loads (HTTP 200). Three bugs had kept the player-script path from ever starting, now fixed: the script URL is read from the page config (jsUrl, PLAYER_JS_URL) because the player response no longer carries assets.js; the 2.66 MB script exceeded the 2 MB fetch cap; and the EJS solver ran out of QuickJS memory at 64 MiB (it needs 256). The live player (sts 20754 and 20759) now solves: n and sig challenges both return answers, about 6 s cold. TVHTML5 then sends its player request, and YouTube answers it UNPLAYABLE (dQw4w9WgXcQ) or LOGIN_REQUIRED (kJQP7kiw5Fk). The current-worktree Cobalt profile also returned UNPLAYABLE for dQw4w9WgXcQ on 2026-11-13; playback succeeded only after fallback to VISIONOS. See modules/samples/black-box-comparison/results/owner-home-2026-11-13-cobalt-profile-recheck.md. Post-update 2026-11-13: signed-out playback now tries VISIONOS before scripted fallback profiles and defers player-script loading until required. The post-change live diagnostic selected VISIONOS, decoded 3,433,755 bytes, and verified a midpoint HTTP 206; see modules/samples/black-box-comparison/results/owner-home-2026-11-13-visionos-first-live.md. Isolated signed-out TVHTML5-only recheck on 2026-11-13 fetched the player script once, then returned 'The page needs to be reloaded.' for dQw4w9WgXcQ before media; no stream, decode, range, or seek evidence resulted. See modules/samples/black-box-comparison/results/owner-home-2026-11-13-tvhtml5-only.md. The JVM suite and iOS arm64 compilation pass. Script-deciphered playback and signed-in playback remain unverified; G4 stays partial.
blockers: No video was served to TVHTML5 on the owner's network: earlier attempts returned UNPLAYABLE or LOGIN_REQUIRED; the 2026-11-13 isolated dQw4w9WgXcQ attempt fetched one player script then returned 'The page needs to be reloaded.' before media. No stream deciphered by the player script has been played. Cloud containers get a captcha instead of the watch page.

gates.name: SABR/UMP
gates.evidence: No SABR network/playback transport. PRs #84, #86, #90 and #91 add only offline framing/response-assembly prototypes and synthetic bounds/continuation coverage; they do not implement or validate service negotiation, media decode or seeking. Closed issue #79 records the 2026-11-11 no-go decision: keep direct plus experimental HLS as interim scope and defer SABR until the independent contract, synthetic-vector and authorized audio/video decode-and-seek re-entry criteria in docs/UMP_FRAMING_RESEARCH.md are met. The bounded 2026-11-12 recheck in docs/UMP_G6_RECHECK_2026-11-12.md found no independently usable contract or authorized transport fixture in the checked primary sources and repository inventory; it does not claim global absence. G6 remains blocked; SABR/UMP playback 0/20. Follow-up research on 2026-11-13 reviewed the MIT-licensed public `davidzeng0/innertube` UMP and `/initplayback` documentation and schemas at commit b04d48d000a84befa5d7b018553b04fa4f98ebd8. It supplies partial bootstrap/envelope, part-ID and seek-message details, but leaves ABR policy, cross-response continuation/order, seek mapping, session, redirect and recovery behavior incomplete; eXcor still has no authorized UMP exchange fixture or playback decode/seek result. No code or schemas were copied. See docs/UMP_G6_RECHECK_2026-11-12.md and docs/UMP_FRAMING_RESEARCH.md. A local 2026-11-13 hardening change now invalidates the offline UMP frame decoder after malformed feed input and frame-limit errors; its focused JVM test passes (7 tests), and shared Android/iOS ARM64 compilation passes. The decoder has no production caller and this local change adds no G6 credit. The full-contract re-entry criterion remains unmet and G6 stays blocked at 0/20. The incremental 2026-11-13 JSR doc recheck found the package/SABR pages at 5.0.1 but the UMP page at 4.1.1, plus a zero-filled synthetic mock example rather than an authorized exchange; see docs/UMP_G6_RECHECK_2026-11-13.md. The offline UMP frame decoder now enforces a 16 MiB default cumulative response-byte limit across feed chunks; a synthetic two-read 8 MiB regression reproduced and then closed the gap. Four focused UMP framing/assembly test classes and the full JVM suite passed with --rerun-tasks; :compileKotlinIosArm64 passed. This adds no G6 credit: there is still no production SABR caller, authorized UMP exchange, live decode or seek result.
blockers: No complete independently validated request/response contract, authorized playable stream, full decode, or seek evidence.

gates.evidence: Supported-target CI passed for merged PR #80 synthetic tests: bounded Retry-After/backoff, cancellation, declared/actual oversized responses, foreign media redirects and credential-safe logs. PR #81 adds session-generation invalidation for player, media and format results, also passing all six supported-target CI jobs. One owner-run signed-out extraction on dQw4w9WgXcQ recovered after a locally injected synthetic 503 with one live player POST, then fully decoded 3,433,755 bytes and passed a midpoint HTTP 206. No upstream endpoint/network fault was induced, and live cancellation remains unverified. PR #102 adds bounded playback-profile exclusion eviction and refresh-recency regression tests (16 profiles per video; 256 videos); all six supported-target CI jobs passed exact head 5768cc2 in run 42999742743. The owner-operated JVM playback diagnostic shares a 256 MiB media-body budget across playback, probing and full decode; synthetic coverage verifies concurrent reservations and prompt child-process termination at the cap. Current worktree verification on 2026-11-13: `:jvmTest --rerun-tasks` passed 257 tests (19 opt-in skips, zero failures/errors). See modules/samples/black-box-comparison/results/owner-home-2026-11-13-live-503-recovery.md.
blockers: One live extraction recovered from a locally injected client-side 503, but no YouTube/network fault or live cancellation was induced; broader live fault/retry reliability remains unverified.
Two nulls in an earlier live run passed on reruns and have not been reproduced.

The broader release-security audit remains incomplete. PR #107 merged as `88fa980` after exact head `78395d6797f4773b518d053e0a2d26ecafdd88d8` passed all six supported-target jobs in run 43025409016; shared engine diagnostics now apply URL/credential redaction, control filtering, 200-character bounds, and valid video-ID track filtering, with a synthetic regression. The broader release-security audit remains incomplete. PR #108 merged as `9a01d03` after exact head `b4cd4ca079a25c125ccdda05ef3bdba0fd5e4562` passed all six supported-target jobs in run 43029076515; caller-facing player rejection exceptions now sanitize upstream reason text, with synthetic cookie, signed-URL and token redaction coverage. PR #124 merged as `e8b1af3080f94f8c30dc82581545de595d08dbb1` after exact head `3fa71184c0b01cb6bc7d12259b973ea1c6f268d8` passed all six supported-target jobs in run 43115947382; host-supplied session cookies, visitor data, region and language now have printable-ASCII and size bounds with synthetic regression coverage. PR #129 merged at 22958ca282a9279eb756e05d8425f6726072b474 after all six jobs passed at exact head in run 43130621290; the post-remediation OSV scan found no issues in 238 all-configuration packages or 115 shipped-runtime packages. CI now treats both the all-configuration and shipped-runtime OSV scans as blocking gates. The CI workflows pin third-party actions to official release commit SHAs, apply `contents: read` to ordinary CI, and restrict the write-enabled score workflow's `workflow_run` job to pushes to this repository's `main`; monthly Dependabot checks action updates. A local TruffleHog v3.99.8 no-verification scan found 9 working-tree matches, all in archived legacy captures or synthetic tests; a Git-history scan found 29 matches in the same areas. The captured API-key-shaped strings remain unverified. Swift now validates host session values and strips cookies, visitor IDs and authorization headers, and disables automatic cookie handling across authorities; exact-main macOS CI run 43441086314 on b23993d passed Swift package tests, including the populated-cookie-jar regression, and the XCFramework notice check. This verified notice files in the generated framework, not native linkage or signed-in playback. Strix could not run locally because Docker and model authentication are unavailable, and no source was uploaded to managed scanning. G12 remains partial because the release-side security audit is incomplete. A separate TruffleHog v3.99.8 no-verification scan of clean-room library, native Swift sources, samples, CI and build tooling returned zero matches; the archived capture/test matches remain unverified. Refreshed 2026-11-13 TruffleHog v3.99.8 no-verification scan across tracked active library/platform/sample code, docs, CI, scripts, API and Gradle inputs, root metadata, and `.claude/settings.json` returned zero matches (zero verified). Archived legacy captures and synthetic-test matches remain outside this active-source scan and retain their prior unresolved status. A 2026-11-13 Swift source review found account cookies attached to returned media headers in both primary and watch-page fallback paths; the Swift live playback test sends those headers to the media URL. Both assignments were removed and regressions added for both extraction paths while preserving cookies on YouTube player API requests. `swift test` could not run on this Windows machine because Swift is unavailable; macOS CI is still required before this fix can count toward G12. A refreshed TruffleHog v3.99.8 no-verification scan after the new sanitized comparison reports covered active library/platform/sample code, docs, CI, scripts, API and Gradle inputs, root metadata, and .claude/settings.json; it returned zero matches and zero verified. Archived legacy captures and synthetic-test findings remain outside this scan. Swift host-session cookie audit (2026-11-13): a host-supplied URLSession could attach automatic cookie-jar credentials to an allowed YouTube media URL. ExcorTransport now disables automatic cookie handling per request while preserving explicit YouTube request headers; a synthetic regression covers a populated jar. The Swift host-cookie regression passed exact-main macOS CI run 43441086314; signed-in live playback remains unverified. G12 stays partial. JVM host-cookie isolation recheck (2026-11-13): a localhost regression with a synthetic host OkHttp CookieJar showed ambient cookies were added to the cloned transport and replaced an explicit Cookie header. The cloned client now uses CookieJar.NO_COOKIES; the test confirms automatic cookies are absent and explicit session cookies remain. :jvmTest passed with 253 tests, 18 opt-in skips, zero failures or errors; :checkKotlinAbi, :jvmJar, :assembleAndroidMain and :preview-android:compileDebugKotlin passed. This verifies the JVM/Android path only. The desktop preview now keeps signed-in cookies in memory and clears the prior plaintext Preferences entry at startup; the desktop self-test passed 2026-11-13. The Android preview now migrates its legacy cookie file into AES-GCM ciphertext protected by Android Keystore and clears WebView cookies after successful import. The API 36 and API 26 (Android 8.0) JoinCheck runs both verify migration, encrypted round-trip, tamper rejection, and sign-out removal of file and key using synthetic data. API 26 also refuses the WebM join path before API 29 as intended; instrumentation reports result=ok. A 2026-11-13 TruffleHog v3.99.8 no-verification working-tree scan, excluding .git and generated build/cache/binary artifacts, found no API-key-shaped matches in archived fixtures after redaction and only two preexisting synthetic URI/JWT test-pattern matches; no findings were verified. The refreshed 2026-11-13 no-verification Git-history scan found 29 unverified findings: 24 API-key-detector hits across three historical YouTube capture paths and five synthetic URI/JWT test findings. No values were printed or verified; Git history was not rewritten. The two sanitized fixture blobs now match the index entries at intermediate legacy paths; sanitized modules copies remain untracked, so reconcile the broader path reorganization before committing. Current worktree verification on 2026-11-13: `:jvmTest --rerun-tasks` passed 253 tests (18 opt-in skips, zero failures/errors); the desktop self-test passed on Java 27; `:preview-android:connectedDebugAndroidTest` passed on API 36 with synthetic `JoinCheck` and CookieVault data. `:checkKotlinAbi`, `:assembleAndroidMain` and `:preview-android:compileDebugKotlin` succeeded with outputs up to date. API 26 is prior evidence; at this local checkpoint Swift/macOS tests had not yet run. Exact-main CI follow-up run 43441086314 later passed the Swift tests and XCFramework notice check; native linkage remains uninspected.
